# Third-party source provenance

Original project: nissmar/PoNQ (MIT), commit dde842b2c00b4a96f67ad07343ae3d48b43fe8ea.

- PoNQ_to_mesh.py: exact original src/utils/PoNQ_to_mesh.py, checked using Git blob SHA-1 and SHA-256. No extraction logic edits.
- mesh_tools.py: the original SIGNS definition and tet_circumcenter function extracted from src/utils/mesh_tools.py. Unused imports and other utilities omitted.
- official_vstars.py: original vstars_from_quadrics function from src/utils/PoNQ.py. Unused package-level classes and imports omitted.
- LICENSE: original project MIT license.

The other code under ../code/ is new experiment, fitting, auditing, and report code; it must not be attributed to the PoNQ authors.
